title: 4.x 内核共用一把 Giant 锁
claim_text: FreeBSD 4.x 时代整个内核由一把大锁（Giant 锁）罩住，任一时刻只允许一个处理器进入内核执行。
quote: Prior to the SMPng project, SMP support in FreeBSD was limited to the i386 architecture and used one giant spin lock for the entire kernel as described in Section 10.2 of [Schimmel94]. This kernel architecture is referred to as pre-SMPng.
publisher_title: Proceedings of the BSDCon 2002 Conference: Locking in the Multithreaded FreeBSD Kernel
notes: 第二源见 smp(4) HISTORY 同义表述（FreeBSD 5.0 起转向细粒度锁）；ref 待主会话四键查重

title: 分叉源于不认同 5.x 内核路线
claim_text: DragonFly 分叉的直接技术理由，是不认同 FreeBSD 5 的内核路线而要在核心部件上另走一路。
quote: DragonFly began as a fork off of FreeBSD-4, because that was the most reliable starting point and because we wanted to do major core pieces of the system quite differently from the direction FreeBSD-5 took.
publisher_title: OSNews: Interview with Matthew Dillon of DragonFly BSD
notes: 主证为创始人访谈自述（talk_interview），故取 L4；第二源为 Handbook 第 1 章（对 release 5 方向日益不满）

title: 分叉起点取自 FreeBSD 4.8 代码库
claim_text: DragonFly 以 FreeBSD 4.8 发行版代码库为起点，分叉于 2003 年 6 月宣布。
quote: DragonFly was announced in June of 2003. The code base was taken from the 4.8 release of FreeBSD, which offered better performance and more complete features.
notes: 两源同域名不同文献；History 页另有“forked from FreeBSD 4.8 in June of 2003, by Matthew Dillon”句

title: 线程结构与内核栈成对缓存复用
claim_text: LWKT 把线程结构与内核栈成对缓存复用，缓存量名义上为 32 组。
quote: Nominally cache up to 32 thread + kstack structures.
publisher_title: DragonFly 源码 sys/kern/lwkt_thread.c（官方 GitHub 镜像 HEAD）
notes: 第二源为 thread.h 的 TDF_ALLOCATED_STACK 注释（/* objcache allocated stack */）；两源同库不同文件，非跨机构独立，宜在批记披露；原 thesis 称“压缩栈”须同批改写

title: 每颗 CPU 各有调度器
claim_text: 每颗 CPU 各有一套自成一体的轻线程调度器，本地调度只需临界区，向别的处理器派活经异步 IPI 排队。
quote: Each cpu in a system has its own self-contained light weight kernel thread scheduler, which means that generally speaking we only need to use a critical section to avoid problems.
publisher_title: DragonFly 源码 sys/kern/lwkt_thread.c 文件头注释（官方 GitHub 镜像 HEAD）
notes: 第二源 Hsu 论文“Cross-processor scheduling is implemented via asynchronous inter-processor interrupts”；同文件另有“Foreign thread scheduling is queued via (async) IPIs”句

title: 消息取用与回复都经端口
claim_text: 轻线程之间的消息经端口投递，接收方按端口取用，回复沿消息登记的回复端口回投。
quote: The reply is sent to the reply port that is registered on the original message. Messages can be replied to synchronously or asynchronously.
doc_date: 未印（在线手册页脚无日期）
notes: 原题“分派与回收”另含消息结构复用义（同页“The sent message structure is reused for replies”），单源，未入 claim；第二源 Hsu Table II 列 lwkt_getport／lwkt_replymsg

title: 无消息可取时线程睡在端口上
claim_text: 端口上没有消息可取时，接收线程睡在该端口上，直到有消息到达才被唤醒。
quote: The lwkt_waitport() function checks the specified port for available messages, dequeues the first one and returns it. If no messages are available then the caller thread will sleep until a message arrives on the specified port.
doc_date: 未印（在线手册页脚无日期）
notes: 第二源 Hsu Table II“Waits for a message to arrive on a port.”；唤醒路径同页 lwkt_replymsg“wake up the waiter”

title: token 自 1.0 起充当内核串行化单位
claim_text: token 自 DragonFly 1.0 起充当内核串行化单位，令牌归属 CPU 而不归线程，线程只持有其引用。
quote: LWKT tokens first appeared in DragonFly 1.0. Shared tokens first appeared in DragonFly 2.11.
notes: 第二源 locking(9)“Tokens are not owned by a thread, but by the CPU, and threads are only given references to tokens.”

title: token 内有自旋锁兜底
claim_text: token 与自旋锁分层实现：token 代码内部使用排他自旋锁，自旋锁只护短小片段，不得跨越阻塞。
quote: Both the token code and the lockmgr(9) code use exclusive spinlocks internally.
notes: 第二源 locking(9)“They are mainly used to protect kernel structures, and to implement higher level locking primitives.”；同页另有自旋锁不得跨越阻塞的条件句

title: 各子系统逐个拆锁减轻全局争用
claim_text: DragonFly 逐个把内核子系统改为细粒度锁，官方称内核已几乎不存在瓶颈与锁争用。
quote: DragonFlyBSD has virtually no bottlenecks or lock contention in-kernel. Nearly all operations are able to run concurrently on any number of cpus.
publisher_title: dragonflybsd.org 首页“What is DragonFly BSD?”
notes: 第二源 History 页“Major kernel subsystems were also scaled one after another.”与 2011 年 VM 细粒度锁句；同域名不同文献，宣称性措辞宜按 L3 处理

title: token 须按取得逆序释放以免死锁
claim_text: token 可递归取得，但必须按取得的逆序释放，否则会死锁；线程显式阻塞时其全部 token 释放，恢复后重取。
quote: Tokens may be taken recursively. However, tokens must be released in the reverse order they were acquired.
notes: 第二源 spinlock(9)“mindful of ordering deadlocks”；阻塞释放句见 token(9)“all its tokens are released, and reacquired when the thread resumes”；原题“SMP 下的验证负担”无一手支撑，题旨已收窄

title: 中断以线程身份参与内核调度
claim_text: 中断以线程身份参与 LWKT 调度，快速中断与线程化中断并存；持自旋锁期间中断线程不能抢占当前线程。
quote: A thread can only be pre-empted by an interrupt thread. Both fast interrupts, where the interrupt is handled in the current thread context, and threaded interrupts, where the LWKT scheduler switches to the interrupt thread and back when it's done, are supported by the LWKT system.
notes: 第二源 spinlock(9)“Holding one or more spinlocks will disable thread preemption by another thread (e.g. preemption by an interrupt thread)”；PDF 未印日期，年份据文件名与论文集

title: 重调度前先凑齐所需 token
claim_text: 调度器处在架构中心位置：重调度前先代线程取得其所需的全部 token，凑不齐就不让该线程运行。
quote: The scheduler takes care of acquiring a token before rescheduling, so a thread will not be run unless all tokens for it can be acquired.
notes: 第二源 Hsu“A lot of work went into separating the LWKT scheduler from the user process scheduler.”（含 per-cpu roundrobin 描述，原文作 LKWT）

title: 重写几乎全部内核而留存驱动接口
claim_text: DragonFly 的重构范围是重写几乎所有原有代码，同时保留与 FreeBSD 5 兼容的驱动接口以承接受代价。
quote: A combination of intentional simplification of certain classes of locks to make more expansive subsystems less prone to deadlocks, and the rewriting of nearly all the original codebase using algorithms designed specifically with SMP in mind, has resulted in an extremely stable, high-performance kernel
publisher_title: dragonflybsd.org 首页“What is DragonFly BSD?”
notes: 第二源为 Dillon 访谈“maintaining a FreeBSD-5 compatible (or mostly compatible) device driver API”；兼容成本的量化面（工期与回归）无公开一手，不应入 claim

title: 驱动移植成本归驱动作者
claim_text: 移植成本转给驱动作者：DragonFly 要求移植 FreeBSD 互斥锁写法的驱动时改用 lockmgr 锁，以维持兼容。
quote: Lockmgr locks should be used for FreeBSD compatibility when porting drivers that use FreeBSD's mutexes.
notes: 第二源 Dillon 访谈（维持 FreeBSD-5 兼容驱动 API 以引入其驱动工作）

title: 在稳定旧库上逐步换掉核心
claim_text: DragonFly 选择在稳定的旧代码库上做增量改造，核心部件逐步替换而不另起炉灶。
quote: Because DragonFly is built on an existing very stable code base, it is possible to make these radical changes as part of an incremental process.
notes: 第二源 Dillon 访谈“The work has been a combination of new work, like our light weight kernel threading core, plus selective backports from FreeBSD-5 to keep the system's device drivers up to date”

title: 4.x 已停止更新只能择取 5.x 驱动
claim_text: FreeBSD 4.x 代码库对新代码与维护更新已不再供给，FreeBSD 的新编码集中在 5.x，DragonFly 只能转向 5.x 取驱动。
quote: But the FreeBSD-4 codebase is of strictly limited utility as a source of new code and maintainance updates. FreeBSD developers are doing nearly all new coding in the FreeBSD-5 branch.
publisher_title: OSNews: Interview with Matthew Dillon of DragonFly BSD
notes: 仅当事人自述一源（原文 maintainance 拼写照录）；第二源检索记录见 c1-closed-draft-20261125.tsv；不得升 filled_candidate

title: 十六名提交者撑不起全线并行
claim_text: 2004 年项目仅有 16 名有写权限的提交者，创始人明言人力不足以同时推进基础设施与硬件跟进。
quote: It is currently comprised of 16 committers with write privileges to the source repository and a community of outside contributors who submit bug patches
notes: 第二源 Dillon 访谈“we don't have the manpower to be able to accomplish both our infrastructure goals”；引文原句续“and help with”，此处截断保真
